title: Trapdoors to redstone lamps
description: Retexture the iron trapdoors to make them look like redstone lamps
body:
## Retexture iron trapdoors to redstone lamps !

Did you know that redstone lamps turn on instantly but need 2 ticks to turn off again?

Well, this, for redstoners, is horrible in certain cases.
But with this pack you will be able to turn iron trapdoors to redstone lamps

From now on, if you place an iron trapdoor in the **top-half block state**, the model will change into a redstone lamp.
Also, when you will power the trapdoor, the model will change again, displaying a lit redstone lamp _(Doesn't emit light tho, resource packs are still not capable of this)_

- Inspired by the [Mattpack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mattpack) (a pack that has the same feature but with a redstone lamp texture non-vanilla)
